title: Ops Signal Socket: PD/Slack adapter with rollback playbook templates
creator: Maya Chen
description: Build a lightweight "ops-signal-socket" service that standardizes outgoing alerts to PagerDuty and Slack and automatically attaches contextual telemetry + selectable rollback playbook templates. This ticket covers the adapter, runbook template registry integration, PD event idempotency, and a small automation flow that can insert a pre-approved rollback snippet into PD/Snowball events for on-call responders.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter sends PD v2 events with trace and span-url attachments within 3s of alert creation
Slack alert messages render with compact telemetry summary and buttons: Acknowledge / Run Rollback / Open Runbook
PD incidents created by the adapter are idempotent (duplicate suppression by external_id) across retries
Runbook templates are selectable from Confluence registry and the chosen template is linked in both PD and Slack notifications
Telemetry attachments are size-limited (<= 250KB) and strip PII/credentials per policy
Automated rollback action inserts a pre-approved playbook snippet into the PD incident body and creates a companion PR draft when code changes are required
tasks: Design adapter proto and event payload (include external_id, severity, timing, trace_ids)
Implement PD v2 sender with retry/backoff and external_id dedupe
Add Slack message builder with interactive buttons and ephemeral confirmation flow
Wire runbook template registry API (Confluence) and caching layer
Implement telemetry summarizer: top-3 spans, top-5 traces, recent errors snippet
Add privacy filter pipeline to strip secrets/PII from attachments
Create migration for existing alert producers to emit ops-signal compatible events
End-to-end tests: PD creation, Slack render, runbook insertion, rollback action flow
Performance test: validate adapter handles 2000 alerts/minute in burst mode
technical_notes: We will send PD events via PD v2 events API using external_id composed of service_name + alert_hash to avoid duplicate incidents
Telemetry attachments will be preprocessed client-side: summarize, redact, gzip/base64 -> store in S3 for >250KB and include signed link in PD/Slack
Interactive Slack buttons call a small secured webhook; confirm flows require SSO verification for high-severity rollbacks
Rollback playbooks are templated snippets stored in Confluence; we fetch via registry and allow parameterization (cluster, rollout id)
Risk: including attachments may leak sensitive metadata — we will apply a redaction schema and run security_review_required before initial rollout
Rate limits: PD has 50 req/s account limit; adapter batches low-severity alerts into digest events every 30s to avoid throttling
Idempotency: use a two-phase create (check existing by external_id, create if missing) to avoid duplicate PD incidents during retries
Telemetry summarizer will prefer traces with highest error counts and include tokenized KV cache snapshots (no secrets)
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal ops team only, 1% of alerts routed through adapter (feature flag)
Beta: expand to 25% and include a synthetic workload that simulates high-latency incidents
Canary: dedicated customer sandbox (RD-Enterprise) for Dedicated capacity customers with opt-in
GA: enable by default for new alert sources; existing sources migrated over three sprints with rollback toggle
Post-launch: runbook usage telemetry + A/B test two rollback phrasing variants to measure operator adoption
